page.layout: One printed page. Running text in one main column; a narrow column of marginal notes on the left (Fannotius, de Repubi., Veneta, Pontanus, Hiftor., Danica); a right margin with a few faint notes at the edge; running head at top; page number 616 at top left.

main_text.p: comprehendit: Aëtium przlio victum, pacifci, dimiffis Hunnis, coëgit. Johannes Placidia Fannotius juffu obtruncatus eft. Ibidem VENETA Refpublica exordium fumfit. Cum enim Attila Italiam de Repubi. liam invafurus diceretur; Veneti, in maris Adriatici ciftuaria, Pataviniis, Aquileje, & Concordiæ Civibus authoribus, confugére; & prima Venetæ urbis fundamenta in Rivo altojecére, ibidemque templum ad Divum Jacobum dedicavere. Primum eam Confules gubernarunt: Veneta ex fingulis infulis finguli cum poteftate perpetua Tribuni. Sub his, tempeftate à Gothis vel Longobardis ingruente, incrementum urbs fumfit; Opitergio a Rothare Rege Longobardorum deleto, Heraclia condita; everfo Altino, Torcellum extructum; exundante Heraclienfium multitudine, Aequilium in formam oppidi redactum & Metamaricum ædificiis occupatum eft. Hiftoria illius fub Juftiniano redibit.

Pontanus l. 1. DANICA hiftoria hic redit, & regnavere ibi ad Anaftafii tempora Svvardus, cui Gothanus Suecus, Scaniam; Slavi veró Jutiam, filio Jarmerico cum filiabus parvulis in captivitatem abductis, ademere. Buthlus frater, qui elapfo è cuftodia Jarmerico, imperium abdicavit. Jarmericus, qui Suecos, Gotharo oppreffo, Daniæ Regno fubjecit; Sembis ac Curetibus obfequiifi reverentiam impofuit; Claffem Slavorum navali przlio delevit; & ob uxorem Suevildam, quam falsò delatam fupplicio affecerat, miferè interiit. Brederus, qui adulterii cum noverca Suavilda, fufpectus, ad laqueum damnatus, à Bicone de-latore fervatus eft. Svvaldus, de quo nihil oc-curDanica

page.notes: Scan is heavily worn and skewed; the right-hand margin and the lower lines are partly lost. Marginal notes are read approximately and marked as doubtful where unclear. The reading of the Danish names is uncertain.
